result.instructions: Use graph tools first for structural code discovery: search_graph to find symbols, trace_path for callers and callees, get_code_snippet for exact source, query_graph for complex multi-hop patterns, and get_architecture for orientation. Use search_code or filesystem grep for literal or non-code text, or when graph coverage is insufficient. Call list_projects before initial use and index_repository only when a repository is not indexed or to force immediate freshness after a large external update. Once indexed, watched projects auto-refresh in the background; use index_status for project health and check_index_coverage for every cited path and for scopes behind negative or exhaustive claims. Coverage is best-effort, never proof of completeness. Check has_more or nextCursor and paginate when present.
